   - Specializes limits across route categories (`AUTH` 15 req/min, `MEDIA` 300 req/min for proxy-image, `GENERAL` 180 req/min) in `apps/api-rust/src/infra/rate_limit.rs`.

   - Redis token bucket uses an atomic Lua script ensuring proper TTL setting and repair.
   - Verified by integration tests in `apps/api-rust/tests/rate_limiter_test.rs` via `apps/api-rust/scripts/test.sh` (14/14 suites passed).

2. **Targeted Cache Updates & Replacing Mass Invalidations (Next.js Web Client)**:
   - In `apps/web/src/app/cabinet/hooks/use-bookmark-mutations.ts` and `apps/web/src/app/cabinet/cabinet-dashboard.tsx`, blanket `invalidateAllQueries()` calls were replaced with granular invalidation callbacks (`invalidateBookmarks`, `invalidateFolders`, `invalidateTags`, `invalidateDuplicates`).
   - Mutations use optimistic cache updates (`updateBookmarkInCache`, `removeBookmarkFromCache` in `use-bookmark-cache.ts`) across infinite and single query caches.

3. **Client-side Retry-After Throttling (Next.js Web Client)**:
   - `apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts` implements response and request interceptors that parse `Retry-After` headers on 429 responses and track `throttledUntil` cooldowns.
   - Request interceptor blocks bursts during active cooldowns with `RateLimitCooldownError`.
   - Polling loops in `use-bookmark-enrichment.ts`, `cabinet-dashboard.tsx`, `activity/page.tsx`, and `operations/page.tsx` pause when `isRateLimited()` is true.
   - Verified via unit test suite (`rate-limit-interceptor.test.mjs`), all 95 `@cabinet/web` tests passing, and clean production builds with zero TypeScript errors.

The implementation of the new Modular Monolith backend in Rust (`apps/api-rust`) has been inspected and audited against all criteria of the objective and `prd.md`:

1. **Skema Database PostgreSQL 17 & Indexing:**
   - Skema DDL terverifikasi di `migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql` memanfaatkan `UUIDv7`, ekstensi `pg_trgm`, serta trigger otomatis `trg_bookmarks_search_vector_update` dengan pembobotan *simple dictionary* (A: title, B: domain/url, C: description/notes).
   - Partial composite index (`WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`) diterapkan untuk feed utama, folder feed, favorites, domain, dan url_hash. Constraint `UNIQUE(user_id, client_request_id)` menjamin idempotensi request client.

2. **Dual Auth (Cookie & Bearer):**
   - Diimplementasikan di `modules/auth/middleware.rs` dan `service.rs`: mendukung ekstraksi otomatis `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (Mobile/Extension/Desktop) dan `Cookie: cabinet_session=<token>` (Web App). Password diamankan dengan `Argon2id` dan session token disimpan dalam bentuk hash SHA-256 (`token_hash`).

3. **Jalur Simpan Instan 'Save-First, Enrich-Later':**
   - `POST /v1/bookmarks` melakukan insert instan berstatus `PENDING` dan melempar job ke antrean Redis `queue:interactive` tanpa memblokir koneksi ke client.
   - Prinsip *"Fill-Missing, Never Overwrite User Intent"* terverifikasi: field yang telah diedit manual (`user_edited_title`, `user_edited_desc`) tidak tertimpa saat background worker selesai mengekstrak metadata.
   - Keyset (cursor) pagination diimplementasikan murni berbasis `(is_pinned, created_at, id)` tanpa `OFFSET`, dan `note_document` dikecualikan dari query listing.

4. **Background Worker Aman (SSRF Guard & Streaming Parser):**
   - `infra/http_client.rs` menerapkan blokade komprehensif terhadap IPv4 (RFC 1918, CGNAT, 127.0.0.0/8, link-local/cloud metadata 169.254.169.254) dan IPv6 (loopback, ULA, link-local), serta memvalidasi setiap langkah redirect (maksimal 5 redirect).
   - `worker/enrichment.rs` menggunakan streaming parser `lol_html` dengan batas memori maksimal 1 MB dan *early abort* begitu tag `</head>` terdeteksi.

5. **Optimistic Concurrency Control (Notes 409) & Folder/Tag:**
   - `modules/notes/service.rs` memvalidasi kesesuaian `base_revision` vs `current_revision` serta melakukan update atomik bertahap, mengembalikan `HTTP 409 Conflict` jika terjadi modifikasi konkuren. Idempotensi `save_id` didukung untuk autosave replay.

6. **Media Storage (Cloudflare R2) & Pipeline Thumbnail:**
   - `POST /v1/media/presign` memvalidasi kuota penyimpanan user (`storage_used_bytes + size_bytes <= storage_quota_bytes`) dan men-generate AWS SigV4 Presigned PUT URL.
   - `POST /v1/media/:id/confirm` mengupdate kuota penyimpanan secara aman dalam transaksi database.
   - `worker/thumbnail.rs` mengonversi gambar ke format WebP lebar maksimal 640px di bawah perlindungan `Semaphore` tokio untuk mencegah lonjakan RAM pada VPS 2 GB.

7. **Search Engine & Public Share:**
   - `GET /v1/search` menggabungkan `ts_rank_cd(search_vector, ...)` dengan toleransi typo `word_similarity(..., title) >= 0.35`.
   - `GET /v1/share/:token` menyajikan bookmark publik tanpa mengekspos notes privat, arsip, maupun tempat sampah.

8. **OpenAPI Kontrak & Verifikasi Uji:**
   - Seluruh 26 model/DTO kontrak v1 terdefinisi dalam `ApiDoc` Utoipa dan diekspor ke `openapi.json`.
   - Seluruh rangkaian test integrasi (`cargo test`) lulus 100% (auth, bookmarks CRUD, keyset pagination, notes conflict 409, worker dual-queue, ssrf guard, r2 media presign, webp resize, search FTS/trigram, public share, dan full e2e lifecycle smoke test).
   - Binary rilis berjalan hemat memori (~11 MB RSS), memenuhi alokasi VPS 2 GB RAM.

activity.report:
Berdasarkan audit independen terhadap repositori dan implementasi backend Rust + Axum (`apps/api-rust` / `cabinet-api`), kelima fitur pelengkap esensial telah selesai diimplementasikan secara menyeluruh dan terverifikasi: 1. **Endpoint Preview Polling Hemat Bandwidth**: - Diterapkan pada `GET /v1/bookmarks/previews?ids=...` (`src/modules/bookmarks/service.rs`). - Mengambil subset data ringkas (`id`, `metadata_status`, `title`, `description`, `thumbnail_url`, `favicon_url`, `site_name`) dengan batasan maksimal 50 ID per panggilan untuk meminimalkan alokasi memori dan bandwidth. - Diverifikasi melalui test suite `tests/previews_polling_test.rs`. 2. **Alur OAuth Google & GitHub (PKCE & CSRF State)**: - Diterapkan pada `src/modules/auth/oauth.rs` dan `src/modules/auth/handlers.rs` dengan route `/v1/auth/authorize/:provider` dan `/v1/auth/callback/:provider`. - Menghasilkan PKCE `code_verifier` dan `code_challenge` (S256), menyimpan CSRF state di Redis dengan TTL 600 detik, menukar kode otorisasi dengan token profil Google/GitHub, melakukan auto-link akun berdasarkan email terverifikasi, serta mendukung deep link mobile (`cabinet://auth/callback?token=...`). - Diverifikasi melalui test suite `tests/oauth_flow_test.rs`. 3. **Engine Import/Export Bookmark HTML Standar Netscape dengan Pelacakan Progres**: - Parser HTML rekursif di `src/modules/tasks/parser.rs` mengekstrak struktur folder bersarang (`

`) dan link (`
`). - `TasksService::import_html` melacak progres impor di tabel `background_tasks` (`PROCESSING`, `total_items`, `processed_items`, `failed_items`, `COMPLETED`), mempertahankan relasi hierarki folder, serta mengantrekan proses metadata ke Redis. - Exporter di `src/modules/tasks/export.rs` menghasilkan HTML format standar Netscape Bookmark File via endpoint `GET /v1/bookmarks/export` dan `GET /v1/tasks/export-html`. - Diverifikasi melalui unit test parser dan integration test `tests/import_export_test.rs`. 4. **Deteksi Duplikat & Broken Link Checker**: - Deteksi link duplikat (`GET /v1/bookmarks/duplicates`) mengelompokkan bookmark berdasarkan `url_hash` normalisasi. - Pembersihan duplikat (`POST /v1/bookmarks/duplicates/cleanup`) menggunakan window function `ROW_NUMBER()` untuk mempertahankan bookmark tertua dan me-soft delete entri redundan. - Health checker (`POST /v1/bookmarks/:id/health`) menggunakan `SsrfSafeClient` untuk mencegah SSRF ke IP privat/cloud metadata, memperbarui `link_health` (`OK`, `REDIRECT`, `BROKEN`), `http_status_code`, dan `last_checked_at`. - Diverifikasi melalui test suite `tests/duplicates_and_health_test.rs`. 5. **Middleware Rate-Limiting Berbasis Redis**: - Diterapkan di `src/infra/rate_limit.rs` menggunakan token bucket / fixed window via Redis `INCR` & `EXPIRE`. - Mengekstrak identitas klien secara bertingkat (hash bearer token, cookie session, atau IP klien). - Mengembalikan HTTP 429 Too Many Requests lengkap dengan header standar `Retry-After`, `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, dan `x-ratelimit-reset`, serta memiliki mekanisme fail-open jika Redis tidak tersedia. - Diverifikasi melalui test suite `tests/rate_limiter_test.rs` dan dihubungkan pada layer Axum di `src/main.rs`. 6. **Pembaruan OpenAPI Spec & Verifikasi Regresi**: - Binary rilis terkompilasi sukses dan flag `--export-openapi` berhasil memperbarui `openapi.json` (23.7 KB) mencakup seluruh schema DTO baru. - Seluruh 16 tes di 12 test suite Rust lulus 100% tanpa kegagalan.

1. **Granular Rate Limiting & TCP Peer IP Resolution (Axum)**:
   - Specializes limits across route categories (`AUTH` 15 req/min, `MEDIA` 300 req/min for proxy-image, `GENERAL` 180 req/min) in `apps/api-rust/src/infra/rate_limit.rs`.
   - `extract_client_identifier` falls back to `axum::extract::ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>` to extract peer IP, paired with `into_make_service_with_connect_info::<SocketAddr>()` in `main.rs`.
   - Redis token bucket uses an atomic Lua script ensuring proper TTL setting and repair.
   - Verified by integration tests in `apps/api-rust/tests/rate_limiter_test.rs` via `apps/api-rust/scripts/test.sh` (14/14 suites passed).

2. **Targeted Cache Updates & Replacing Mass Invalidations (Next.js Web Client)**:
   - In `apps/web/src/app/cabinet/hooks/use-bookmark-mutations.ts` and `apps/web/src/app/cabinet/cabinet-dashboard.tsx`, blanket `invalidateAllQueries()` calls were replaced with granular invalidation callbacks (`invalidateBookmarks`, `invalidateFolders`, `invalidateTags`, `invalidateDuplicates`).
   - Mutations use optimistic cache updates (`updateBookmarkInCache`, `removeBookmarkFromCache` in `use-bookmark-cache.ts`) across infinite and single query caches.

3. **Client-side Retry-After Throttling (Next.js Web Client)**:
   - `apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts` implements response and request interceptors that parse `Retry-After` headers on 429 responses and track `throttledUntil` cooldowns.
   - Request interceptor blocks bursts during active cooldowns with `RateLimitCooldownError`.
   - Polling loops in `use-bookmark-enrichment.ts`, `cabinet-dashboard.tsx`, `activity/page.tsx`, and `operations/page.tsx` pause when `isRateLimited()` is true.
   - Verified via unit test suite (`rate-limit-interceptor.test.mjs`), all 95 `@cabinet/web` tests passing, and clean production builds with zero TypeScript errors.

1. **Granular Rate Limiting & TCP Peer IP Resolution (Axum)**:
   - Specializes limits across route categories (`AUTH` 15 req/min, `MEDIA` 300 req/min for proxy-image, `GENERAL` 180 req/min) in `apps/api-rust/src/infra/rate_limit.rs`.
   - `extract_client_identifier` falls back to `axum::extract::ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>` to extract peer IP, paired with `into_make_service_with_connect_info::<SocketAddr>()` in `main.rs`.
   - Redis token bucket uses an atomic Lua script ensuring proper TTL setting and repair.
   - Verified by integration tests in `apps/api-rust/tests/rate_limiter_test.rs` via `apps/api-rust/scripts/test.sh` (14/14 suites passed).

2. **Targeted Cache Updates & Replacing Mass Invalidations (Next.js Web Client)**:
   - In `apps/web/src/app/cabinet/hooks/use-bookmark-mutations.ts` and `apps/web/src/app/cabinet/cabinet-dashboard.tsx`, blanket `invalidateAllQueries()` calls were replaced with granular invalidation callbacks (`invalidateBookmarks`, `invalidateFolders`, `invalidateTags`, `invalidateDuplicates`).
   - Mutations use optimistic cache updates (`updateBookmarkInCache`, `removeBookmarkFromCache` in `use-bookmark-cache.ts`) across infinite and single query caches.

3. **Client-side Retry-After Throttling (Next.js Web Client)**:
   - `apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts` implements response and request interceptors that parse `Retry-After` headers on 429 responses and track `throttledUntil` cooldowns.
   - Request interceptor blocks bursts during active cooldowns with `RateLimitCooldownError`.
   - Polling loops in `use-bookmark-enrichment.ts`, `cabinet-dashboard.tsx`, `activity/page.tsx`, and `operations/page.tsx` pause when `isRateLimited()` is true.
   - Verified via unit test suite (`rate-limit-interceptor.test.mjs`), all 95 `@cabinet/web` tests passing, and clean production builds with zero TypeScript errors.

<approved/>
